passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS The following Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations (“MD&A”) is intended to help the reader understand the results of operations and financial condition of Microsoft Corporation. MD&A is provided as a supplement to, and should be read in conjunction with, our consolidated financial statements and the accompanying Notes to Financial Statements (Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K). This section generally discusses the results of our operations for the year ended June 30, 2026 compared to the year ended June 30, 2025. For a discussion of the year ended June 30, 2025 compared to the year ended June 30, 2024, please refer to Part II, Item 7, “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended June 30, 2025. OVERVIEW Microsoft is a technology company committed to making digital technology and artificial intelligence (“AI”) available broadly and doing so responsibly, with a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We create platforms and applications, powered by AI, that deliver innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of our customers. We generate revenue by offering a wide range of cloud-based solutions, content, and other services to people and businesses; licensing and supporting an array of software products; delivering relevant online advertising to a global audience; and designing and selling devices. Our most significant expenses are related to compensating employees; supporting and investing in our cloud-based services, including datacenter operations; designing, manufacturing, marketing, and selling our other products and services; and income taxes. Highlights from fiscal year 2026 compared with fiscal year 2025 included: • Microsoft Cloud revenue increased 27% to $214.4 billion. • Commercial remaining performance obligation increased 84% to $678 billion. • Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 17%. • Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue increased 28%. • LinkedIn revenue increased 11%. • Dynamics 365 revenue increased 18%. • Azure and other cloud services revenue increased 41%. • Windows OEM and Devices revenue decreased slightly. • XBOX content and services revenue decreased 5%. • Search advertising (formerly Search and news advertising) revenue excluding traffic acquisition costs increased 12%. Industry Trends and Opportunities Our industry is dynamic and highly competitive, with frequent changes in both technologies and business models. Each industry shift is an opportunity to conceive new products, new technologies, or new ideas that can further transform the industry and our business. At Microsoft, we push the boundaries of what is possible through a broad range of research and development activities that seek to identify and address the changing demands of customers and users, industry trends, and competitive forces. credit_strengths.text: Microsoft's revenue and operating income have grown steadily across the last three fiscal years, with operating margin well above the software sector median. This reflects the durable, high-margin nature of its cloud and productivity franchises, which generate substantial recurring cash flows even through technology spending cycles.

Operating cash flow covers capital expenditures many times over, leaving free cash flow that dwarfs reported debt. The company holds a net cash position when short-term investments are included, and its indicative financial risk profile is minimal, supported by leverage far below the sector median.

key_risks.text: The debt note discloses a large current portion of long-term debt maturing within the next twelve months, a sharp increase from the prior year. While the company's cash generation can easily cover this, refinancing or repayment will consume a meaningful share of balance sheet liquidity.

The risk factors passage highlights intense competition and rapid technological change, including the need to invest heavily in AI and cloud infrastructure. Capital expenditures already absorb a substantial portion of operating cash flow, and any acceleration could pressure free cash flow available for debt service or shareholder returns.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is exceptionally high, with operating income covering gross interest expense by a wide margin, far exceeding the sector median. Cash paid for interest is even lower than accrued expense, indicating no near-term liquidity strain from debt service obligations.

Free cash flow to debt stands well above one time, and the current ratio is adequate though below the sector median. The company's net cash position, after considering short-term investments, means debt servicing relies on a fraction of recurring cash generation, leaving ample headroom.

overall_credit_view.text: Microsoft's credit profile is anchored by minimal leverage, massive cash generation, and a net cash position. The indicative financial risk profile is minimal, and the company's scale and market position in cloud and software provide a strong buffer against cyclical or competitive pressures.

Forward-looking judgement: the company's ability to fund capital expenditures, dividends, and buybacks from operating cash flow while reducing debt should preserve credit strength. However, the upcoming maturity wall and heavy AI investment warrant monitoring, though the overall risk remains low.

credit_strengths.text: 微軟的營收與營業利益於過去三個財政年度穩定增長，營業利潤率遠高於軟體業中位數。此反映其雲端與生產力業務具備持久且高利潤率的特質，即使經歷科技支出週期，仍能產生大量經常性現金流。
營業現金流覆蓋資本支出達數倍，留下之自由現金流遠超帳面債務。計入短期投資後，公司持有淨現金部位，且其指示性財務風險狀況極低，獲槓桿遠低於行業中位數所支持。

key_risks.text: 債務票據披露，長期債務中有大額流動部分將於未來十二個月內到期，較上一年度大幅增加。儘管公司之現金產生能力可輕鬆覆蓋，再融資或償還仍將消耗資產負債表流動性之可觀份額。
風險因素章節強調激烈競爭與快速技術變革，包括需對人工智能及雲端基礎設施進行大量投資。資本支出已吸收營業現金流之重大部分，任何加速均可能對可用於償債或股東回報之自由現金流構成壓力。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率極高，營業利益覆蓋總利息支出之幅度寬闊，遠超行業中位數。已付利息現金甚至低於應計費用，顯示債務償付義務並無近期流動性壓力。
自由現金流對債務比率遠高於一倍，流動比率充足惟低於行業中位數。計入短期投資後，公司之淨現金部位意味著償債僅依賴經常性現金產生之一小部分，留有充裕緩衝。

overall_credit_view.text: 微軟之信用狀況以極低槓桿、龐大現金產生及淨現金部位為錨。指示性財務風險狀況極低，且公司於雲端與軟體之規模及市場地位，為抵禦週期性或競爭壓力提供強大緩衝。
前瞻性判斷：公司從營業現金流中撥付資本支出、股息及回購，同時削減債務之能力，應可維持信用實力。然而，即將到來之到期牆及對人工智能之巨額投資值得監察，惟整體風險仍然偏低。
